_about: Each traced ground's boundary line as the match plays it (tools/grounds/boundary/fit_boundary.py). frame: [x, z, degrees] in the model's glb metres: the goals' midpoint and the line through them. boundary/fence: r(t) = a0 + sum(a_k cos kt + b_k sin kt) about that midpoint, t from the +x goal towards +y (the glb's +z after the turn).

blacktown.source: NSW Spatial Services aerial (SIX Maps, CC BY 4.0), current; tile set nsw (date not given by the service), 0.075 m pixels. AFL markings visible. Painted line traced as the ridge of a thin bright line with lit grass 1.5 m either side, along 1440 rays, then a 12-term Fourier radius about the centre fitted to the points seen. Goals: middle of the goal line from a 6.4 x 9 m goal-square template; checked against the 50 m arcs (arc50_check_m: radius at which each arc is found round its goal). Placed on Google Earth by matching ground-level edges 110-280 m from the centre against the audit's 600 m straight-down GE shot (shift east +0.09, north -0.12 m).

trace_error.placement_on_google_earth: about 1 m: the government aerial and Google Earth agree to 0.15 m overall (two of four quarters within 0.5 m)

cazalys.source: Google Earth 3D top-down captures (2026-11-22), GE pinhole geometry calibrated on the 50 m centre square (50.0 m). line: centre of the painted boundary ridge, one point per 2 m window, 320 windows on 16 tiles round the ground. goals: middle of each goal line between the goal-post bases (shadow roots) on two d=95 m top-downs. centre: midpoint of the two goals, NOT a measured centre circle. fence: fence base, 2 m windows (shadow-corrected), kept points of the 0.32 m rms ellipse fit.

gmhba.source: Google Earth 3D, close straight-down shots (130 m camera) stitched; tile set gem (Google Earth's current 3D imagery, viewed 2026-11-22), about 0.08 m pixels. AFL markings visible. Ten straight-down Google Earth shots from a ~130 m camera round the boundary, stitched into one east/north picture at 0.08 m. Painted line traced as the ridge of a thin bright line with lit grass 1.5 m either side, along 1440 rays, then a 12-term Fourier radius about the centre fitted to the points seen. Goals: middle of the goal line from a 6.4 x 9 m goal-square template, checked against the 50 m arcs. Centre: 50 m centre square + 10 m circle template.

trace_error.placement_on_google_earth: Google Earth itself (the frame the GMHBA origin was solved in from 7 GE wall-foot points); camera heights read off GE's status bar to 1 m (about 0.7% in scale); the 50 m arcs come out at 49.7 and 50.2 m

north_hobart.source: Google Earth web historical imagery: aerials of 8 Feb 2022 (anchor) and 2 Oct 2024, straight-down captures at 0.132 m a pixel. Each date's painted line traced along 1440 rays; 2024 lined up on 2022 by the line itself (shift [3.535, 2.05] m) and the median taken. Goals: 50 m arc then the goal square (north-east goal on both dates, 0.49 m apart; south-west goal 2022 only).

trace_error.placement: Google Earth places the 2022 and 2024 aerials 4.1 m apart, so the frame is the 2022 aerial's (line, goals and fence all from it). Checked against main's model (a first draft by eye) in a match top-down render: model fence edge minus traced fence median -0.32 m, p5-p95 -1.6 to +2.3 m; painted line in the match vs trace rms 0.40 m.

riverway.source: Google Earth web historical imagery: aerials of 6 Jun 2024 (anchor) and 22 Apr 2023, straight-down captures at 0.132 m a pixel. Each date's painted line traced along 1440 rays; 2023 lined up on 2024 by the line itself (shift -1.08, +2.21 m, rms 0.34 m) and the median taken. Goals: 50 m arc then the goal square (south goal on both dates, 0.25 m apart; north goal 2023 only).

trace_error.placement: Checked against the model on main in a match top-down render: traced fence vs the model's fence edge median -0.24 m; on the open side (east, north, south) within +0.6 m; on the grandstand side the model's sign rail sits 1.1-1.9 m inside the real fence (the concourse wall), like GMHBA's sign ring.
